prompt.generated_prompt_string: Using the attached adult identity reference as mandatory source, create a vertical top-down cinematic portrait of the same adult man lying relaxed on a red couch in a messy, stylish retro living-room setup. Preserve his exact identity, face, age presentation, thick wavy hair, and core features. Dress him in a dark checked shirt, brown trousers, sunglasses, and earphones connected to a smartphone resting on his chest. Surround the couch with vinyl records, compact cameras, audio cables, a vintage amplifier, generic paperback books, and an unbranded dark glass bottle. Use warm practical lamp light, soft overhead fill, tactile retro materials, fine analog grain, and nostalgic amber shadows. Render branding, labels, book titles, record sleeves, or packaging text only when their exact approved reference artwork is attached; otherwise keep all props unbranded. No watermark.
